atAGlance: Gỏi vịt is duck salad, usually with cabbage, herbs, ginger fish sauce, peanuts, and sliced duck.
whatItIs: Gỏi vịt is duck salad with shredded or sliced duck, cabbage or banana blossom, rau răm, onion, peanuts, and ginger fish-sauce dressing.
howToEnjoy: Toss lightly so the duck catches the ginger dressing without losing the crunch of the greens. Ask for peanuts out before the salad is mixed if needed.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi vịt as a shared salad, often alongside cháo vịt. Ask for less spice, no peanuts, or extra ginger fish sauce before it is tossed.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, duck salad often travels with duck porridge: rich meat, crunchy greens, rau răm, and ginger dip balancing one another.
goodToKnow: Rau răm gives the salad its peppery herbal lift; it is part of the duck flavor, not decoration.
